name: JaSaPaGe
description: Japanese pangenome, 66 samples plus CHM13v2 and GRCh38 (134 haplotypes). Built outside pggl-graph; this manifest was written by hand afterwards and is the negative control for scripts/validate-graph.sh: its GRCh38 is fragmented.

seqfile.note: The FASTA paths in it no longer exist

build.note: No build log survives. reference_order is taken from the GBWT reference_samples tag and the GFA RS tag (both 'CHM13v2 GRCh38') and from the seqfile, which lists CHM13v2 first. The date is the mtime of the outputs.

image.note: Digest taken on 2026-09-23 from the SIF the indexes were built with (image built 2026-09-21 15:06, index jobs submitted from 15:07)

fasta.note: The linear FASTA the CRAMs were encoded against; not taken from the graph

pansn_dict.note: SN:GRCh38#0#<contig> with lengths from GRCh38.fa.fai. vg surject needs it to fold the fragments back into their contigs.

gbz.note: Format inferred: vg 1.70 reads it, and vg 1.70 only reads GBZ format 1

snarls.note: Shipped with the graph, made by the vg inside Cactus

hapl.note: Rebuilt locally; replaces the shipped JaSaPaGe.hapl

shipped_hapl.note: Rejected by vg 1.70, which requires format 5. Superseded by graphs.clip.hapl.

chm13_ref_paths.note: ref_paths for the CHM13v2 target (ref_path_prefix CHM13v2#0#), whose 25 paths are whole

known_issues: GRCh38 is not the first --reference, so it is stored as 166 paths, 165 of them subranges such as GRCh38#0#chr1[585988].
pangenome-aware DeepVariant cannot call against GRCh38: it resolves each contig name to that contig's first fragment only.
vg surject needs reference.pansn_dict; a plain path list drops the fragments from @SQ and leaves the reads unmapped.
vg call writes ##contig lengths 10-83 kb short (the end of the last fragment); pggl-workflow's vg-call-sv.sh rewrites them from the .dict.
The graph covers 92.4% of GRCh38 by length and 97.6% of its non-N bases; clipped centromeric and satellite sequence cannot be called.
The shipped JaSaPaGe.hapl is format 4, which vg 1.70 rejects; graphs.clip.hapl is a local rebuild.
